page_title: STU 3-3 MAI | Stuttgart v Mainz 31/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' 3 - 3 It's a goal! Maxim Leitsch (Mainz) gets on the end of a pass and it allows him to finish into an empty net with a close-range header. The score has changed to 3:3.
90+4' Stuttgart are ruled offside.
90+2' OFF THE BAR! Fabian Rieder (VfB Stuttgart) strikes a brilliant shot towards goal from the free kick, but his effort rattles the crossbar.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart) comes onto the pitch for Maximilian Mittelstadt.
88' Fabian Rieder (VfB Stuttgart) shows what an intelligent of a player he is after hitting a low shot from a free kick that goes under the defensive wall and into the bottom left corner!
87' That's the end of the game for Jae-Sung Lee, who is replaced by Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz).
87' Bo Henriksen decides to make a substitution. Nadiem Amiri will be replaced by Aymen Barkok (Mainz).
87' Handball! A player from Mainz handled the ball.
85' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
84' Stuttgart couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Robin Zentner (Mainz) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
84' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) earns the yellow card.
83' Timo Gerach interrupts the game. One of the players from Mainz won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A free kick is awarded to Stuttgart.
83' Stuttgart have a corner.
81' Stuttgart failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
80' The resulting set piece from Stuttgart is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Stuttgart get a corner.
79' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
79' The attendance is 59000.
75' A cross is whipped in towards El Bilal Toure (VfB Stuttgart) on the edge of the six-yard box. He wins the ball but sends his header just wide of the right post.
74' We are about to witness a substitution. El Bilal Toure (VfB Stuttgart) is replacing Jamie Leweling.
74' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to substitute Deniz Undav and he is replaced by Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart).
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Silvan Widmer (Mainz) replaces Anthony Caci.
73' The goal by Mainz is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
73' The Mainz players joy may have been justified, because referee Timo Gerach is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
71' Lasse Riess (Mainz) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
71' Mainz have a goal ruled out for offside!

70' The ball is out of play and Stuttgart manage to earn a corner. Fantastic run and shot from mid-range by Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart), but a defender denies him an almost certain goal by getting his body in the way.
67' The corner is swung in but Stuttgart can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
66' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Stuttgart.

65' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed shot towards the left side of the goal, but Robin Zentner pulls off a fantastic save to deny him. Stuttgart have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
64' Bo Henriksen has decided to make a change. Armindo Sieb (Mainz) replaces Hyun-Seok Hong.
64' Hyun-Seok Hong (Mainz) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
62' 2 - 2 Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) jumps for a cross and plants a brilliant header into the top right corner.
59' A pass into the penalty area from Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) is intercepted by the defence.
57' The referee is firm and issues Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) a deserved yellow card.

57' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the left side of the goal. Robin Zentner is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
55' Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
54' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) strikes the ball from the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but his effort goes high over the bar.
53' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Timo Gerach had an easy-decision to make.
52' Stuttgart take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

51' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) bursts inside the box, beats two defenders and produces a strike from the penalty spot. The shot has power, but lacks precision and the goalkeeper stops it easily. The scoreline remains the same.
49' Stuttgart failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
48' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Stuttgart force a corner. They send men into the box.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Bo Henriksen gives a chance to Maxim Leitsch and Stefan Bell (Mainz) is off.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Sebastian Hoeness probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart). He is replaced by Josha Vagnoman.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) comes off for Fabian Rieder.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) sends a chip pass into the box, but Robin Zentner is quickest to intercept the ball.
45+2' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
45+1' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' 2 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Alexander Nubel no chance!
43' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
42' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for Mainz.
37' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Mainz, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
36' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) was quite harsh and Timo Gerach didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
35' The ball goes out of play. Mainz are awarded a corner kick.

34' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Alexander Nubel guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
32' Stuttgart can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
31' Wow, what an escape. Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. Stuttgart force their opponents to concede a corner.
29' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
27' Alexander Nubel (VfB Stuttgart) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
24' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
22' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!

20' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Alexander Nubel was alert and the score remained the same.
19' Some great controlled play and passing from Stuttgart. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

15' 2 - 0 Goal! Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the top right corner. Robin Zentner had no chance of reaching it. The score is 2:0.
14' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.
12' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
11' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
8' 1 - 0 Goal! Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) has the simplest of tasks to roll the ball into an empty net from close range after a rebound left the keeper stranded. 1:0.
7' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner which is cleared.
6' Hyun-Seok Hong (Mainz) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Mainz will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
5' Stuttgart have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

4' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Robin Zentner pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the bottom right corner.
4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Stuttgart comes to nothing.

3' Great solo effort by Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) as he tricks his way through two defenders before firing a drive from just outside of the box towards the roof of the net. The goalkeeper is ready and produces a stunning save. Good work from Stuttgart as they win a corner.
1' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) plays a through ball but overhits it.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Stuttgart will take the kick-off.
Timo Gerach was nominated as the referee for this game.
